item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Scholz endorsed violations of civilian protection, prisoner treatment, or humanitarian law. I also found no direct evidence of German battlefield conduct in 2024 to measure proportionality or necessity in a strict operational sense, because Germany was not the principal belligerent. The strongest limitation is that the record is mostly about Germany’s diplomatic and arms-policy stance toward other actors’ operations, not about German operations themselves. I found very little direct evidence on prisoner treatment beyond hostage-release demands.
